# FTMO — How to Import Trades from FTMO into TradeZella Using the File Upload Method?

Source: https://help.tradezella.com/en/articles/10395516-ftmo-how-to-import-trades-from-ftmo-into-tradezella-using-the-file-upload-method

Important Note: If you’re using FTMO with cTrader, MetaTrader, or another supported platform, you can sync your account directly with TradeZella.



For those who prefer the file upload method, follow this straightforward guide to ensure your trading data stays accurate and up-to-date.



## Exporting Trade Data from FTMO

- Log in to your FTMO Client Area.

Log in to your FTMO Client Area.

- Click on the Accounts Overview tab in the left-side panel.

Click on the Accounts Overview tab in the left-side panel.

- Under the account you want to export trades for, click MetriX.

Under the account you want to export trades for, click MetriX.

- Scroll down to the Trading Journal section and click the blue Export button on the right-hand side.

Scroll down to the Trading Journal section and click the blue Export button on the right-hand side.

- Select CSV to export your trades into a CSV file.

Select CSV to export your trades into a CSV file.



## Uploading the Exported File into TradeZella

- Visit the TradeZella Add Trade page here or by clicking the “Add Trade” button on the sidebar.

Visit the TradeZella Add Trade page here or by clicking the “Add Trade” button on the sidebar.

- On the Add Trade page, click “Add New Account” if you’re creating a new account for these trades.

On the Add Trade page, click “Add New Account” if you’re creating a new account for these trades.

If you’re uploading trades to an existing account, simply click on the “Add Trades” button in the account field:

- On the Add New Account page, select FTMO as the broker and click Continue.

On the Add New Account page, select FTMO as the broker and click Continue.

- Next, select the File Upload method and click Continue again.

Next, select the File Upload method and click Continue again.

- On the final step, select the timezone of the file and upload the file. The system will handle the rest.

On the final step, select the timezone of the file and upload the file. The system will handle the rest.



That’s it! The system will process your data and update your account accordingly.
